findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a new instance, discarding logged messages on the receiver
findings.body: `TestLogger.FromContext` returns `NewTestLogger()` instead of `f`. When code under test calls `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)` (as `LoggerMiddleware.logRequest` now does), the log call is recorded on the newly allocated `TestLogger` and immediately discarded, leaving the original `TestLogger` passed into `NewLoggerMiddleware` with `InfoLogs.Calls == 0`. Any unit test asserting on a `*log.TestLogger` passed to `LoggerMiddleware` will fail to observe logs written via `FromContext`.

findings.title: ContextualLoggerMiddleware dereferences nil request pointers without nil checks
findings.body: `ContextualLoggerMiddleware.QueryData`, `CallResource`, `CheckHealth`, and `CollectMetrics` immediately access `req.PluginContext` without checking whether `req == nil`. Previously, `InstrumentationMiddleware` failed early via `pluginRegistry.Plugin` lookup on `QueryData`/`CallResource` or only after other checks, while `LoggerMiddleware` (and other middlewares in `clientmiddleware`) explicitly guard with `if req == nil { return m.next.<Method>(ctx, req) }`. Passing a nil request through the middleware chain will now panic with a nil pointer dereference in `ContextualLoggerMiddleware`.
